video.title: What is a Gold IRA & How Does It Work?

summary: Casper Capital explains US gold IRAs: self-directed retirement accounts holding IRS-approved physical metals in approved storage, with traditional or Roth tax treatment. It covers purity rules, contribution limits, RMD penalties, fees (setup about $50, custodian $75-200 a year, storage about $100), pros and cons, scams and markups, and setup steps. It recommends a 10-15% allocation as a hedge. There is no business idea; it is US-only personal finance content with affiliate links to gold IRA providers.

quote.text: Gold just hit record highs near $3,800 an ounce
quote.speaker: Casper Capital narrator

quote.text: the average 401k balance is about $137,800, and the average IRA balance is about $131,366 in 2025
quote.speaker: Casper Capital narrator

quote.text: contribution limits, $7,000 per year or $8,000 if you're 50 or older
quote.speaker: Casper Capital narrator

metric_claims.claim: Missed RMD penalty 25% (10% if fixed quickly)

quote.text: If you miss one, the penalty can be 25% of the shortfall reduced to 10% if you fix it quickly
quote.speaker: Casper Capital narrator

metric_claims.claim: Gold IRA fees: ~$50 setup, $75-200/yr custodian, ~$100/yr storage

quote.text: you usually pay setup fees around $50, annual custodian fees from $75 to $200, storage fees around $100 per year
quote.speaker: Casper Capital narrator

metric_claims.claim: Allocate 10-15% of a $200k portfolio (~$20-30k) to gold as a hedge

quote.text: if you put 10 to 15% into gold, around 20 to 30,000, you create a hedge
quote.speaker: Casper Capital narrator

metric_claims.claim: Segregated storage sometimes billed $1.80 per $1,000 of gold

quote.text: Sometimes the fee is build as $1.80 every $1,000 of gold you own with a minimum charge
quote.speaker: Casper Capital narrator

tactics.name: Choosing a gold IRA provider
steps: Get setup, annual admin and storage fees in writing
Ask for the buy/sell spread in writing
Confirm eligible coins/bars, shipping, insurance and timelines
Fund via direct transfer rollover to avoid withholding

warnings.warning: Dealers have been fined for hidden markups on coins sold to retirees.

quote.text: Some firms have been fined for selling coins with hidden markups to retirees
quote.speaker: Casper Capital narrator

warnings.warning: Avoid collectibles and proof coins, which cost more but don't resell for more.

quote.text: Avoid collectibles and proofs which cost more, but don't always sell for more
quote.speaker: Casper Capital narrator

warnings.warning: Gold IRA fees are much higher than index-fund IRAs; gold pays no income and can be illiquid.
IRA gold cannot be stored at home.

quote.text: You also cannot have it stored at home
quote.speaker: Casper Capital narrator

lessons.lesson: Gold is a hedge and diversifier, not a growth engine; broad indexes have outperformed it long term.

quote.text: Over the long run, broad stock indexes have outperformed gold
quote.speaker: Casper Capital narrator

lessons.lesson: Always get fees and spreads in writing before buying through a dealer.
Younger investors chasing growth are usually better in index funds.
Direct transfers are the safest way to roll over retirement money.

evidence_quality.rationale: Second-hand educational content, US-only; affiliate promotion of gold IRA dealers.
